failures.test: login.spec.ts:83 redirects a reloaded login page when a valid BFF session already exists
failures.rootCause: pre-existing global app defect: on a warm HTTP cache the second document load of any route resolves the modulepreload graph before the inline import map registers, so '#entry' cannot resolve; Nuxt renders its 500 error page and onMounted never runs (no session fetch, no redirect)
failures.owner: build/config (lead) — not fixable in this workstream's files
failures.after: fail (unchanged: 500 page, Failed to resolve module specifier "#entry")

failures.test: login.spec.ts:181 focuses the first invalid field when client validation fails
failures.rootCause: the submit button was bound to TanStack canSubmit, which is false as soon as a blurred field is invalid; the click retried against a disabled button for 30s and never submitted. Second defect: focusFirstInvalidField ran before Vue flushed the aria-invalid patch
failures.fix: :disabled="isSubmitting || verifying" (archive parity) + await nextTick() before focusing
failures.after: pass (desktop batch-05 2 passed; mobile batch-10 2 passed)

failures.rootCause: the archived origin (frozen frontend/dist) cannot serve /uploads/img/config/badge.svg (404) so its ClubAvatar falls back to /brand/group-avatar.webp, while the app renders the configured badge_image; the desktop-only ClubAvatar (hidden lg:block) is why mobile passes
failures.fix: route the archive's **/uploads/** to the app origin, as support/public-parity.ts#useUpstreamFixtures does
